rules.statement: A party invoking the provisions of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance to defeat ownership must establish a starting point for their acquisition of prescriptive rights.
rules.supporting_quote: lt is trite law that where a party to an action for a declaration of title to a land invokes the Provisions of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance in order to defeat the ownership of an adverse claimant to immovable property, the burden of proof rests squarely and fairly on him to establish a starting point for his or her acquisition of prescriptive rights.
